external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2667 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
external_only_references.version_note: Official Dutch-language EUR-Lex record; the English official text and instrument identity were reviewed on 2026-10-23. Article 7i includes an accelerated-procedure safeguard for family members within Directive 2004/38. This is an amending act, not a consolidated Visa Code. Under Articles 7(1) and 8(2), general application depends on a Commission decision; Article 8(3) gives earlier dates for specified provisions. Verify the decision and national notifications before treating the EU Visa Application Platform as operational. The reference does not establish local-copy acceptance or topic coverage.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2023/2685 on digitalisation of the visa procedure
external_only_references.version_note: Official English text and instrument identity reviewed on 2026-10-23. This amending act changes the uniform visa format to a digital format, but Article 3 defers general application to a Commission implementing decision under Article 2(1), with a limited exception for Article 1 point 2 from 27 December 2023. Check the decision in the Official Journal before describing digital visas as operational. This is not a consolidated text of Regulation (EC) No 1683/95. The official Dutch route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1240 establishing ETIAS
external_only_references.version_note: EUR-Lex identifies the current consolidated version dated 12 June 2026. Article 2(1)(c) covers visa-exempt third-country family members of Union citizens or equivalent free-movement beneficiaries who lack the specified residence card or permit; Article 2(2)(b)-(c) excludes qualifying cardholders. On 2026-10-23 the official ETIAS FAQ said the system was not operating and no applications were being collected; the Commission scheduled launch for Q4 2026 without an exact date. Recheck official operational status and the actual residence document before applying. The Dutch route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.
